audit_type: Independent read-only sample of actual completed compact records; no model, noise, null or bootstrap rerun
sample_selection: Deterministic models×nominal small/middle/large sizes×f=.0001,model threshold,1×replicates0/1/95; Goryachev C50 added as current largest completed fallback. Only COMPLETE status archives read.

float32_tolerances.dominant_amount_ordering: 8float32epsilon×largestamount; unresolved stored ties do not prove unique double-precision ordering

limitations: This is a deterministic sample, not the final all260condition numerical audit.

Full native profile histories are intentionally absent after extraction, so this audit cannot redetect every native region independently. All ragged identities/counts/dominance are checked internally; independent field component counts are checked only where retained float16 exemplars preserve the full native grid and quantization cannot change the threshold classification.
Binned exemplars support a conservative Fourier-moment check, not a claim of exact native region completeness.
Gaussian knot fingerprints and unchanged frozen generator/protocol hashes are verified; Gaussian paths are not regenerated.
Running and unstarted records are listed as unaudited, never failures or fabricated missing outputs.

subsequent_analysis_contract_qualificati.scope: Original sampled schema audit remains at-time evidence; no additional compacts or model outputs were rerun.
subsequent_analysis_contract_qualificati.method_correction: Accepted dominant-ID tenures define lambda counts/exposure and median MSD fit range. Missing accepted centroids split only displacement segments. This changes analysis of existing histories, not native generation or stored records.
